description: Fill in a project's own columns on one issue, by their NAMES: 'Segment=AI; Country=Poland; Started=2026-08-01', or a JSON object. A country column takes the country's name or its two-letter code. An empty value clears the field, which is not the same as an empty one. A value that does not fit the field's kind — an option nobody offered, a date that is not one, a country that is neither — refuses the WHOLE call rather than writing part of it.

values.description: Field names to values, as 'Segment=AI; Country=Poland' or a JSON object. List values are given by option name, people by username, dates as 2026-08-21.

name: set_issue_fields
